title: sqlite-graphrag migrate --to-llm-only response
description: JSON contract for the `migrate --to-llm-only --drop-vec-tables --json` subcommand added in v1.0.76, updated in v1.0.77 with null_rows_fixed (G40) and vec_tables_removed_via_writable_schema, updated in v1.0.78 with v013_tables_created (G41 phantom registration repair). The one-shot upgrade for v1.0.74 / v1.0.75 databases: rehash + apply V013 + report vec-table state. Requires --drop-vec-tables as an explicit safety guard. Corrected by GAP-SG-271, which ran the command and validated the real envelope for the first time: the document required `action` and `vec_tables_dropped` and typed `rewritten` as an integer, none of which `ToLlmOnlyReport` in src/commands/migrate.rs has ever serialized, and it declared `embedding_tables_created` and `namespace`, which it never emits either. The dropped tables are reported by the COUNT in `vec_tables_removed_via_writable_schema`, not by name. Under `additionalProperties: false` that rejected every real answer, and the published example did not validate against its own schema either.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

status.description: The single value the handler writes. A failure never reaches this envelope; it is reported through error-envelope.schema.json.

rehashed.description: One element per migration row whose checksum the rehash step rewrote. Empty when every checksum already matched. Same element shape as `rewritten` in migrate-rehash.schema.json.

v013_applied.description: True when migration V013 was applied during this invocation. False when the schema was already at or beyond V013.

schema_version.description: Current schema_version after the operation. Never null: an unreadable history reports 0.

vec_tables_were_present.description: True when vec_memories, vec_entities, or vec_chunks virtual tables were detected in sqlite_master before the drop.

db_path.description: Absolute path of the database file that was processed.

null_rows_fixed.description: Number of refinery_schema_history rows where applied_on was NULL and got fixed. Added in v1.0.77.

vec_tables_removed_via_writable_schema.description: Number of sqlite_master entries removed via PRAGMA writable_schema when the vec0 module was absent. Includes root tables and shadow tables. Added in v1.0.77.

v013_tables_created.description: True if the BLOB-backed embedding tables (memory_embeddings, entity_embeddings, chunk_embeddings) were created by the G41 repair helper because V013 was registered in history but the tables did not exist. Added in v1.0.78.
